name: Linking R2: dev/sealed split of linking-v1 parts 2 and 3, single-oblique role relabeling, frame tier, article stripping and circuit rules in the chat turn
registered_by: linker-r2-agent (follow-up of eval-linking-v1; targets of linking proposal section 6.2)
kind: evaluation-only (no training; SymbolicLM programs cached from eval-linking-v1; no new judge labels)
frozen_before_results: Written after the dev half had been read once for diagnosis (the M3 numbers of eval-linking-v1 are on the full, partially seen set) and before the sealed test half was read at all. The sealed half is measured once, at the end.
hypotheses: H1 (recall): on the dev half, relation accuracy of the R2 linker exceeds the M3 linker on the same half (36.1%) with the paired interval excluding zero, through role relabeling, frames and article stripping.
H2 (clarification): the unjustified clarification rate on gold-bind rows falls below the M3 value on the same half (33.5%).
H3 (safety): the wrong-link rate does not grow against the M3 linker on the same half (14.8%) beyond what newly bound rows explain; the number against predicates without facts is reported apart.
H4 (sealed): the sealed test half confirms the direction of H1 to H3 (one measurement, no tuning on it).

system_under_test.chain: question (message only) -> SymbolicLM (cached programs of eval-linking-v1) -> compileDeclarative (KnowledgeLinker: sop/knowledge-linker.mjs, sop/linking.mjs, sop/propositions.mjs, sop/frames.mjs, sop/copula-linker.mjs, the host dictionary) over the lexicon of world-v1 with core-en layered under it; no engine run
changes: frame tier before the dictionary tiers (sop/declarative.mjs tryLink; synonym and role levels)
leading article stripped when an entity surface finds nothing (sop/lexicon.mjs matching)
chat turn carries the circuit rules (server/session-runtime.mjs, sop/runtime.mjs, reasoning/slice Theory.chatRules): checked by tools/linking/acceptance-chat.mjs, not by the linking suite

data.split: eval/suites/linking-v1/split.json: parts 2 and 3 (502 judged rows) split by form (part x gold relation or ask, 82 forms) with a fixed-seed hash, alternating dev and test inside a form; 256 dev, 246 test. Dev is tuned on freely; test is sealed (tools/eval/linking-open.mjs run --half test, once).
data.labels: unchanged from eval-linking-v1 (judge consensus); no relabeling.

stages: The dev half is run whole (it is small and cheap: seconds); the sealed half once at the end.

stopping_rules.broken: the sealed half is not read until the dev work is finished; if dev compile errors exceed 1% or the wrong-link rate on dev rises more than 3 points over M3, stop and fix before any sealed read
stopping_rules.futile: not applicable (a deterministic compile step, seconds per run)
stopping_rules.decisive: not applicable (full dev half each run)

deviations: The memory changed under the evaluation: worldkb-agent remapped world-v1 onto core-en predicates during the task, and the english-core-agent made the core English-only. Labels judged against the old vocabulary are read through PREDICATE_RENAMES (one-to-one renames) in tools/eval/linking-open.mjs. Romanian rows (about one in eight) score 0 by design after the owner decision (translate at the edges); the report gives the English rows apart (by_language).

The M3 linker could not be run on the new memory, so H1 to H3 are compared with the M3 numbers of the same half measured before the work (dev 36.1% relation, 14.8% wrong-link, 35.3% unjustified) and with the exact arm on the new memory.
No new LLM labels were needed (no judge calls).
changes_after_registration: Added during the dev work (all read from the dev half only): converse lexeme frames, the integer-role type_mismatch clarification, the relation/object boundary shift, namesake descriptions in entity clarifications, a guard on the frame tier (not for the copula; the linked predicate must have facts), the core-en builder telling holders of a shared form apart by role classes, forms use/win in core-en and direct in world-v1.
Romanian items (name inflection, ro forms) were started and removed again after the owner decision of 2026-10-01 (English-only core).

results.hypotheses: H1 yes on the direction (sealed scored over exact +6.2 points; dev over the M3 half +1.3 points on all rows, +6.2 on English rows) but far from the section 6.2 targets; H2 partly (unjustified 34.0% sealed against 44.8% exact; not under 5%); H3 not met (wrong-link 12.1% against 1% target; it is dominated by generic verbs bound where the memory has no facts); H4 confirmed in direction on the sealed half.
